preconditions.description: The number of planets N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of Hyperspace™ highways M must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i < v_i <= N for u_i, v_i in highways)
preconditions.description: Each highway connects two different planets within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_j < b_j <= N for a_j, b_j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query specifies two different planets within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly Q lines, one for each query.
Each output line must represent a valid minimal number of highways, which must be at least 1.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[j]) == minimal_highways(a_j, b_j) for j, (a_j, b_j) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: Each output line must correspond to the minimal number of highways for the respective query.
